en: Hand-colored historic postcard showing a street scene titled "Bergstrasse mit Reichsbank" in Köslin. The view looks down a gently sloping street lined with substantial late‑19th‑century buildings; on the left is a large brick edifice with a prominent balcony and awning (the Reichsbank building), on the right a lighter-colored multi‑story structure. Trees line the street further down, with several pedestrians visible. Printing at the bottom identifies the location and publisher, along with a note that it is a hand-colored artist card.
